Game Overview

Tunnel Race Ball is a arcade game built around guide a ball through an endless tunnel of obstacles, collecting points by touching circles. Enjoy addictive gameplay and minimalistic graphics while mastering intuitive controls. Timing is key as you dodge treacherous barriers. Plan your path for higher scores and return frequently to challenge your reflexes and beat your high score!

Playing Tunnel Race Ball comes down to a simple loop. Guide a ball through an endless tunnel of obstacles, collecting points by touching circles. Plan your path for higher scores and return frequently to challenge your reflexes and beat your high score!
